resolved_issues.title: Hardcoded Static Mock Fallback in /impact Router Masking Missing Market Data
resolved_issues.remediation_applied: Populated data/raw/market/yahoo_ohlcv.parquet with 4,512 daily OHLCV rows across AAPL, BAC, GS, JPM, MSFT, and SPY from 2022 to 2024 using MarketLoader. Removed the hardcoded static mock dictionary fallback from api/routers/impact.py. Real OLS market models, abnormal returns, CAR, t-stats, and p-values are now calculated dynamically live.
resolved_issues.verification_evidence: GET /impact/JPM_10-K_2024-02-16 returns HTTP 200 OK with real computed CAR = +0.0200 (+2.00%), t_stat = 0.845, p_value = 0.3982, alpha = 0.001848, beta = 0.4884 against live SPY benchmark.

resolved_issues.title: PydanticSerializationError on POST /qa Due to Numpy Array Inside Parquet Chunks
resolved_issues.remediation_applied: Implemented defense-in-depth sanitization: in api/state.py chunks are sanitized upon loading, in src/retrieval/engine.py entities is explicitly typed as List[str], in src/generation/qa_engine.py _sanitize_chunks ensures pure Python primitives, and in api/routers/qa.py _clean_for_json recursively converts all NumPy structures before returning.
resolved_issues.verification_evidence: POST /qa tested live via TestClient and pytest tests/api/test_qa.py. Returns HTTP 200 OK with verified citations, valid confidence, and pure JSON serializability.
